themes.title: Far-right parties exploit migration crises for political gain
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are leveraging migration crises to push nationalist agendas, framing migration as a security and cultural threat. This theme is evident in Spain, Italy, France, Germany, the UK, and Norway, where parties like Vox, Lega, RN, AfD, Reform UK, and FrP are using the issue to rally support and criticize mainstream policies.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Criticizes Spain's handling of migration in Ceuta, demanding stricter controls and health alerts due to alleged disease outbreaks.

countries.name: 🇮🇹 Fratelli d'Italia / Lega
countries.note: Meloni and Salvini push for stricter EU migration policies, including return hubs outside the EU and suspension of Schengen agreements.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Continues to frame migration as a national security issue, proposing stricter border controls and deportation policies.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Uses migration as a key campaign issue in regional elections, advocating for stricter deportation policies and criticizing mainstream parties' handling of migration.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Farage's 'Australia-style' border policy and mass eviction proposals for foreign nationals from social housing highlight migration as a central campaign issue.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Criticizes Norway's immigration policies, advocating for stricter controls and reduced asylum intake.

themes.title: Trump administration targets gender-affirming care and LGBTQ+ rights
themes.blurb: The Trump administration in the U.S. has intensified its focus on restricting gender-affirming care for minors and rolling back LGBTQ+ protections. This theme resonates in Poland and Hungary, where similar policies are being debated or implemented by right-wing governments.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Finalized rules barring Medicaid and CHIP funding for gender-affirming care for minors, sparking legal challenges and criticism from medical professionals.

countries.name: 🇵🇱 Prawo i Sprawiedliwość
countries.note: Continues to push conservative social policies, including opposition to LGBTQ+ rights, aligning with broader right-wing trends in Europe.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Maintains conservative social policies, including opposition to LGBTQ+ rights, as part of its nationalist agenda.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Criticizes progressive social policies, including LGBTQ+ rights, as part of its broader anti-establishment platform.

themes.title: AfD surge reshapes German politics ahead of regional elections
themes.blurb: Germany's far-right Alternative für Deutschland (AfD) is leading in polls for upcoming regional elections in Saxony-Anhalt and other states, prompting mainstream parties to adjust their strategies. This surge is influencing political discourse in neighboring countries like Sweden and Norway, where far-right parties are also gaining traction.

countries.name: 🇩🇪 Alternative für Deutschland
countries.note: Leads polls in Saxony-Anhalt and other eastern states, with potential to form the first far-right regional government in Germany.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: Continues to gain influence in Swedish politics, shaping immigration and integration policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National
countries.note: Monitors AfD's rise as a potential model for far-right governance in France.

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: Gains in Norwegian polls, reflecting broader right-wing trends in Scandinavia.

themes.title: Right-wing governments target social programs amid fiscal debates
themes.blurb: Right-wing governments in Argentina, Hungary, the U.S., and the UK are pushing for fiscal austerity, targeting social programs and public spending. This theme reflects a broader trend of reducing state intervention in the economy and prioritizing fiscal responsibility over social welfare.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Javier Milei's government implements drastic cuts to social programs, including healthcare and education, as part of its austerity measures.

countries.name: 🇭🇺 Fidesz / Tisza
countries.note: Continues to prioritize fiscal austerity, including cuts to healthcare and education funding, while maintaining nationalist policies.

countries.name: 🇺🇸 MAGA / Trump
countries.note: Proposes cuts to social programs, including homelessness funding and Medicaid, while increasing defense spending.

countries.name: 🇬🇧 Reform UK
countries.note: Advocates for reduced public spending and stricter welfare policies, including mass evictions of foreign nationals from social housing.

themes.title: Argentina’s La Libertad Avanza and PRO negotiate electoral alliance
themes.blurb: Argentina's ruling La Libertad Avanza (LLA) and the opposition PRO party, led by Mauricio Macri, are negotiating a potential electoral alliance for the 2027 elections. This cross-party collaboration aims to consolidate right-wing support and challenge Peronist dominance in key provinces like Buenos Aires.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 La Libertad Avanza
countries.note: Karina Milei leads negotiations with PRO to form a strategic alliance, aiming to expand LLA's territorial presence and secure key electoral victories in 2027.

countries.name: 🇦🇷 PRO (Macri)
countries.note: Mauricio Macri re-engages with LLA, seeking to rebuild political trust and coordinate legislative and electoral strategies for 2027.
